beats.narration: On Fri 13 Nov 2026, Robert Chen emails Amelia: his wife Mei died suddenly of a brain aneurysm on 12 Oct, aged 42. He attaches a certified copy of the death certificate and his ID.
Olivia's agent gently extracts the notification: Mei's Corella Life policy CR-19033105, with $1,000,000 of life cover and Robert as her nominated beneficiary.
Olivia opens case REQ-20261113-LIF005, sets the priority to High and flags a bereaved family for human handling.
Theo takes compassionate oversight: one named contact for the family, Amelia, and every message to Robert approved by a person.
Felix's agent checks the death certificate and Robert's ID: both legit.

Ben's agent confirms the policy was in force with premiums paid, no exclusions apply and the nomination is valid, so the benefit is paid straight to Robert, not through Mei's estate. It also finds Mei's $180,000 of default death cover in Riverbend Super, a separate claim with the fund's trustee.
After the Teams approval, Ben's agent lodges the claim with Corella Life on 16 Nov. Corella accepts it on 20 Nov and pays $1,000,000 to Robert on 23 Nov.
Cara's agent drafts gentle letters for Robert, with a simple checklist for the super claim, and a person approves every one.

result.headline: $1,000,000 paid to Robert
result.summary: Outcome: COMPLETED — $1,000,000 paid to Robert on 23 Nov 2026, with Mei's $180,000 super claim under way.
